cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C5 alkyl-sulfate chassis - defining anionic Sodium Lauryl Sulfate@2 with at least two prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3, Coco-Betaine@14, Coco-Glucoside@15) and no reinforcing route. Counter-signal: only the betaine@3 is early; the other two buffers count as prominent only because Parfum is declared last (E3), and they sit after lecithin/NaOH, so strong is the realistic neighbor.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: see rationale (counter-signals recorded there; convention value unchanged by claims, 3.2)

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one cationic polymer (Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@17) plus light routes - Glycerin@8, honey@5-6, weak refatters Glyceryl Oleate@9, Lecithin@12, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@16, pearlizer Glycol Distearate@10. No silicone and no payload lipid, so C2 is not met and high is not supported. Counter-signal: guar is mid-late and the SLS chassis is cleansing-led; low is the neighbor.

wLine.plausibility: (i) Sodium Lauryl Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide-type thickener or pearlizing wax at 21-29

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Exact-product positioning is clearly repair (name + manufacturer), but the formula does not support repair.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction: repair (moderate/high). Formula verdict moisture_supported (glycerin@8, honey@5-6, guar@17, weak refatters) and not repair_supported: no protein, no silicone, no lipid; deposition light (weight low). F1: damage positioning maps to repair only with repair_supported or dual_supported; no moisture claim exists to use the moisture verdict. 'Bienenwachs' is claimed but not in the INCI (note, ID-3 non-material). Decision: general.
focusPrimary.rationale: General: repair claim over a formula whose verdict is moisture_supported, not repair_supported (F1, 3.2: claims cannot override the formula).
